title: Power Star Gianni Paolo, Diddy, & Tamar Braxton All Weigh-In On Viral Joker Video With Diddy & Michael J Ferguson
htmlContent:
Diddy spent an eventful Halloween, painting the city's red dress as Heath Ledger's Joker.

Videos of Diddy in real character went all over the weekend, including one in which he seems to have had a lively exchange with Power actor Michael J. Ferguson.

The clip shows Ferguson, who plays 2-Bit in Power, calling Diddy a "cat", which prompted Diddy to let out a Joker-inspired laugh before calling Ferguson a "clown."

The two then exchanged tougher insults, with Diddy questioning why Ferguson had a problem with him. “Then muthaf***ing get to it, n,” he raged. “If you don’t like me, you muthaf***ing frontin’. Get to it b*****. Don’t f***ing play with me on Halloween. I’m out here with love.”'

“You f***ing p****, make sure you won’t never talk to me like that,” he says. “We’re having a good time. Why you wanna come at me like that? You got a problem? You really taking over my energy right now? What did I do to you? Do you know who I am?”

After the video was shared by The Shade Room, Diddy jumped into the comments to explain that there is no animosity between the two guys. “Had a fun night. It’s all love,” he wrote. “Hugged like Black kings should do when it comes to some bullshit. Love love love.”

Then Power Book II Star Gianni Paolo who plays Brayden Weston chimed with "I’m with Diddy 2Bit rides for Tommy "

Paolo reigniting his online beef with Joseph Sikora who plays Tommy Egan.

Finally, Tamar Braxton wrote, "I told y’all he WON!! Take y’all costumes off and get in The kitchen and start cooking for thanksgiving.. we’re done here!! "

Power Book II: Ghost season three slated to be released in 2023.
